source_identity.title: Evidence for Interstitial Carbon in Nitrogenase FeMo Cofactor
source_identity.inspection_scope: PMC author-manuscript main text, Figure1 caption and citation; linked supplementary PDF and coordinates not acquired

reported_system.state_scope: studied structural and spectroscopic preparations; no redox or catalytic E-state assigned

findings.statement: At 1.0 angstrom resolution the two cofactor-center atoms match the carbon electron-density distributions. The authors revise their earlier nitrogen preference and describe interference from neighboring iron in the older analysis.
findings.evidence_method: X-ray diffraction; reported structural analysis, not project refitting

findings.statement: U-13C-labeled A. vinelandii MoFe protein adds an ESEEM pattern consistent with carbon near or within FeMo; the authors interpret this with the crystal structure.
findings.evidence_method: Isotope-label ESEEM; not independently atom-localizing or a second experimental study
Primary figure caption; no formal charge or oxidation state projected

source_chemistry_binding.source_step_summary: In a nucleophilic substitution reaction the cental nitrogen atom of the cofactor reforms one of its bonds to the one of the iron centres.
